# Spreadsheet interoperability fixtures

These are unmodified upstream test documents. The application metadata identifies the first as LibreOffice and the second as Microsoft Excel.

- `libreoffice-empty.xlsx`: [LibreOffice/core, `9af373d7fec914ac9e7788b06bb3bdba3c3f66df`](https://github.com/LibreOffice/core/blob/9af373d7fec914ac9e7788b06bb3bdba3c3f66df/sc/qa/unit/data/xlsx/empty.xlsx).
- `excel-simple.xlsx`: [apache/poi, `6966eb7d546fe0dc8ae4bd0132e0ea7fa4389c62`](https://github.com/apache/poi/blob/6966eb7d546fe0dc8ae4bd0132e0ea7fa4389c62/test-data/spreadsheet/SimpleNormal.xlsx).

The POI fixture is under the Apache License 2.0. The LibreOffice fixture is under MPL 2.0, as part of the LibreOffice test corpus. The matching license texts are included here. These fixture licenses do not change the library license.

`pixel.png` is a generated 1x1 RGBA test image, created for this repository. It is covered by the repository's MIT license.
